name: gee-r-focused
command:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, sys, time, json
r=Path.cwd(); start=time.monotonic()
with (r/'logs/gee-r-focused.log').open('x') as log:
 code=subprocess.call(['Rscript','--vanilla','dsVert/inst/cross-grid-v2/gee-fixed-rho/run-focused.R',str(r)],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
(r/'logs/gee-r-focused.exit').write_text(str(code)+'
')
print(json.dumps(dict(exit_code=code,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)),flush=True)
sys.exit(code)
